whenToUse: There are many results to narrow by conditions.
There are fixed attributes such as price, size, or color.
whenNotToUse: There are only a few results.
There's one condition and tabs or sorting are enough (use search scope tabs).
There are dozens of conditions that need their own screen.

alternatives.name: Filter Chip
alternatives.reason: Choosing a few conditions in one row.

accessibility: Condition groups are named with fieldset and legend.
Conditions are checkboxes, toggled with Space.
The changed result count is read via aria-live.
Summary chip names say what they remove, such as "Remove white filter".
